'''Tekkur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who worked as a bouncer in the [[Invisible Hand cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
He found his work in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to be relatively quiet, as the clientele were generally peaceful. After he had been there for about a year, the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Tavik Moern]] and some Quarren thugs became involved in a firefight with some [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents in the cantina. Tekkur switched his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to stun and tried to fire at anyone who he thought was causing significant damage to the premises.
